description: This is a Go test source file containing unit tests for repository-related functions in the 'repositories' package. The tests cover functions such as URL processing, database interactions for URL and branch ID retrieval/creation, caching behavior, and mapping diff targets.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by clearing the ID table.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Resets the cache and prepares for subsequent tests.

methods.name: TestProtocolStrippedURL
methods.description: Tests the removal of URL protocol from a given URL.

methods.name: TestGetOrCreateURLBranchID
methods.description: Tests creating and retrieving URL-branch IDs, ensuring consistency.

methods.name: TestGetOrCreateURLBranchIDCache
methods.description: Tests cache behavior when retrieving URL-branch IDs.

methods.name: TestGetURLBranchByID
methods.description: Tests fetching URL and branch details by ID.

methods.name: TestGetURLBranchByIDCache
methods.description: Tests cache retrieval when fetching URL and branch by ID.

methods.name: TestGetDiffTargetToMapped
methods.description: Tests conversion of a diff target to its mapped version, verifying IDs.
